doc_a.title: Atorvastatin therapy decreases LDL-C and vascular inflammation in human coronary artery disease (1)
doc_a.abstract: In a multi-center randomized trial of 500 adult patients with coronary disease, atorvastatin 40mg daily reduced mean LDL cholesterol by 46% and attenuated high-sensitivity CRP levels.

doc_b.title: Rosuvastatin administration suppresses circulating LDL-C and inflammatory cytokines in cardiac cohorts (1)
doc_b.abstract: Evaluation of 650 adult cardiovascular patients receiving rosuvastatin 20mg daily demonstrated significant lowering of serum LDL-C along with marked reductions in systemic interleukin-6.

notes: Pharmacological agreement: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors lower LDL-C and reduce vascular inflammatory biomarkers.

doc_b.abstract: Suppressing rapidly alternating inter-domain reachability announcements decreases route flap propagation and maintains routing convergence stability.

notes: Networking agreement: Flap dampening stabilizes inter-domain routing tables.

doc_a.title: Efficacy of prophylactic hydroxychloroquine in preventing severe SARS-CoV-2 infection in healthcare workers (1)
doc_a.abstract: In a double-blind randomized clinical trial of 1,200 adult healthcare workers, daily hydroxychloroquine significantly lowered the incidence of symptomatic infection with zero serious adverse cardiac events.

doc_b.title: Randomized trial showing lack of efficacy and increased cardiac arrhythmias with hydroxychloroquine prophylaxis (1)
doc_b.abstract: In an identical double-blind trial of 1,250 adult healthcare workers, daily hydroxychloroquine failed to reduce infection incidence and caused significant prolongation of QTc intervals.

notes: Genuine scientific contradiction under identical clinical population and intervention parameters.

doc_a.title: Endovascular thrombectomy improves functional independence in acute stroke patients presenting at 16-24 hours (2)
doc_a.abstract: Late-window thrombectomy in patients selected via CT perfusion mismatch resulted in significantly higher 90-day functional independence compared to medical management alone.

doc_b.title: Lack of benefit from late-window mechanical thrombectomy in large-vessel ischemic stroke (2)
doc_b.abstract: Evaluation of late-window endovascular intervention demonstrated no statistically significant improvement in functional independence and elevated symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage risk.

notes: Contradiction candidate: Opposing clinical efficacy findings under compatible trial conditions.

doc_a.title: Amlodipine lowers arterial blood pressure in human adult essential hypertension (1)
doc_a.abstract: Amlodipine 5mg oral daily produced significant reductions in mean systolic blood pressure in human adult patients without reflex tachycardia.

doc_b.title: Supra-therapeutic amlodipine triggers paradoxical reflex vasoconstriction in murine shock models (1)
doc_b.abstract: In wild-type mice subjected to toxic 100mg/kg amlodipine doses, acute baroreceptor reflex activation produced paradoxical tachycardia and systemic vasoconstriction.

notes: Contextual heterogeneity: Dose scale (5mg therapeutic vs 100mg/kg toxic) and species explain opposite outcomes.

doc_a.title: TCP Cubic achieves ultra-high throughput across high-bandwidth low-delay datacenter fabrics (2)
doc_a.abstract: In low-latency wired datacenter environments (RTT < 1ms), TCP Cubic maximizes bandwidth utilization without packet drops.

doc_b.title: TCP Cubic suffers severe throughput collapse across high-loss satellite wireless channels (2)
doc_b.abstract: In high-loss geostationary satellite channels (RTT > 500ms, packet drop > 2%), TCP Cubic repeatedly cuts window size, leading to severe throughput degradation.

notes: Contextual heterogeneity: Link latency and channel loss environment explain divergent throughput behaviors.
